topic.title: Taylor Swift's Eras Tour sold about two billion dollars of tickets: what one night and one seat brought in

title: One night of Taylor Swift's Eras Tour brought in $13.9M
description:
How much did one night of Taylor Swift's Eras Tour bring in?
The Eras Tour sold $2.08B of tickets over 149 sold-out shows. That's about $13.9M a night and $204 a seat.
#TaylorSwift
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Would you have paid for a seat? Comment

lines.text: One night of Taylor Swift's Eras Tour brought in about $13.9M.
And she sold out every one of her 149 shows.
In all, 10.2M seats were filled, in stadiums around the world.
Split the ticket money, and the average seat sold for about $204.
The tour ran for 21 months. So what did it all add up to?
And that's only tickets. Not her pay, not one T-shirt, not one album.
The whole tour sold $2.08B of tickets. Would you have paid for a seat?

notes: 12 figures computed from inputs; 12 cross-checked against closed-form formulas.

All 4 facts confirmed on the source page (spokesman.com, LA Times/NYT, 9 Dec 2024): $2,077,618,725 tickets (Taylor Swift Touring's official total, per verify list, not Pollstar's $2.2B), 149 sold-out shows, 10,168,008 attendees, 21-month tour; final, not superseded. Gross ticket sales never called her earnings (turn beat says 'not her pay'); per-night and per-seat are averages hedged with 'about'/'average'. No advice, tone fine, description ends with disclaimer. Note: description says 'illustrative numbers' though figures are sourced; harmless.
